paragraphs: Alden Systems sells Alden ONE, a platform that automates the business processes behind utility joint use and real estate. It sits between electric utilities, the companies attaching equipment to their poles, and the service firms working in between. The company also names communications and broadband providers and their engineering and construction partners.

Alden ONE is a centralized database holding more than 60 million utility joint use assets and activities. Its stated purpose is getting the right data to the right project partners at the right time by automating processes. Alden says its customers quantify the net gains they have seen.

The company describes gaining SOC 2 compliance as a deliberate decision rather than a checkbox exercise. Its about page names John Sciarabba as chief executive. It also lists itself as a current member of several industry organizations.
